persons.name: Danielle
persons.harm: Her partner used a fabricated identity, coercive control, financial exploitation, threats against her family and threats to abduct their daughter. After she left, harassment, legal proceedings and disclosure of her private address continued.
persons.perpetrator_role: her former partner and the father of her daughter

quotes.quote: I didn't see a way out safely or peacefully. And so I stayed.

I had thought about running away with her and just disappearing, but then I thought, this is a man who knows where my parents live and my half siblings are there, and I wasn't sure if he was capable of showing up with a gun. I mean, he'd been in the military told me he had no problem hitting women constantly. So what was going to stop him from showing up at my parents place and trying to fight my father.

And the reason I held off on doing that was because the custody hearing would be in front of the exact same judge that denied my restraining order. I did not want to risk her giving him any type of custody.

contacts.what_was_asked: Help repair the relationship after discovering infidelity.
contacts.what_institution_did: Provided a few couples-therapy sessions; the story gives no abuse-specific intervention or response.
contacts.quote: Feeling that they could work through this, Danielle got already to agree to attend couples therapy. That was a big deal because it was completely against going to a therapist. We did go to a few sessions, but ultimately we ended up stopping because I had gotten a promotion and I had to move to San Diego.
contacts.what_happened_next: Sessions stopped with the move; deception and control continued.
contacts.notes: The therapy concerns the relationship harm; routine pregnancy and pediatric visits are excluded because disclosure of abuse at those appointments is not shown.

contacts.when: when her daughter was about six months old
contacts.what_was_asked: The detective initiated contact and warned her of possible fraud.
contacts.what_institution_did: Identified discrepancies in the partner's identity and offered her help.
contacts.quote: And the detective listen judging my reaction to some of my questions I feel like you might be a victim of fraud and if you need help you can call me.
contacts.what_happened_next: She ended the call and confronted her partner, who persuaded her to move on.
contacts.notes: The police investigated his report, not a completed prosecution of her abuse.

contacts.what_was_asked: Help her cope and remain safe/sane while she feared leaving.
contacts.what_institution_did: Heard her explanation that she felt trapped; the transcript does not describe a specific protective intervention at this stage.
contacts.quote: And instead, I used my therapist and I said, I just have to stay sane until there's a breaking point, until something happens.
contacts.what_happened_next: She stayed until other survivors and her family helped her leave.

contacts.what_was_asked: Flexibility and reassurance that retaliatory contact would not cost her job.
contacts.what_institution_did: Her boss responded supportively when she disclosed the situation.
contacts.quote: So I called her and I was just like, please don't fire me. I know I've only been on the job for three weeks. And she was really, really great.
contacts.what_happened_next: She continued planning her exit.
contacts.notes: The precise accommodations and an actual retaliatory complaint to this employer are not specified.

contacts.institution: private security hired by her family
contacts.what_was_asked: Protect her and her family while she left and collected her possessions.
contacts.what_institution_did: Provided security at the family home and accompanied the removal of weapons and pets from the apartment.
contacts.quote: So the security guy follows me to our apartment with my dad and basically stands out, I'd watching in Casey somehow shows up. So I got the rifles out, all the ammunition, he had like bow and arrows that he had picked up as a hobby for a total of like two months, but I just basically wanted any sort of weapon out of that house. I also got my two cats.
contacts.what_happened_next: She stayed with family and changed her devices and passwords.
contacts.notes: Private security is an organisation hired to respond to the threats; it did more than receive a report.

contacts.institution: private security at the family home
contacts.what_was_asked: Keep the threatening former partner away from the family.
contacts.what_institution_did: The guard was asleep and did not notice him approach the door.
contacts.quote: And it turns out she'd actually fall on a sleep. And she didn't notice because he didn't even drive his car. He was being sneaky and parked around the corner and basically snuck up.
contacts.what_happened_next: Her father closed the chained door; the partner left as they tried to call police.

contacts.what_was_asked: Protection after the attempted entry and threats against the family.
contacts.what_institution_did: Issued an emergency protective order.
contacts.quote: The police issued an emergency protective order, but I still need to deserve him with it.
contacts.what_happened_next: She still needed to serve the order and sought a longer court order.

contacts.when: first hearing scheduled July 21, 2020, followed by continuances
contacts.what_was_asked: A permanent restraining order, preferably three years.
contacts.what_institution_did: Allowed the respondent time to review evidence and continued the hearing several times.
contacts.quote: After checking into court, Danielle's lawyer gave already copies of all the evidence that would be presented, already then requested a continuance in order to review the evidence.
contacts.what_happened_next: The eventual hearing ended in denial.
contacts.notes: Continuance is recorded separately from the later substantive decision.

contacts.what_was_asked: A permanent order protecting her and her daughter.
contacts.what_institution_did: Rejected her credibility, criticised her not leaving or removing guns sooner, and denied the order.
contacts.quote: So she saw this as me being non-credible and she said she didn't find my testimony credible not just because she saw me reading from my notes but because if I had really felt threatened I would have left the first time he made a threat
contacts.what_happened_next: She remained afraid, changed lawyers and tried public exposure instead.
contacts.notes: The quoted reasoning also blames the victim; the denial left her without the protection sought.

contacts.what_was_asked: Legal help and a way to expose the false identity.
contacts.what_institution_did: Advised creating a factual website using public court records.
contacts.quote: So she also suggested a website and I was like, could that be considered slander? She said, well, as long as you don't post private information and you're only posting facts, you're good. You can even post the domestic violence cases because they're public records.
contacts.what_happened_next: Danielle created the site; it helped later survivors find her.
contacts.notes: Legal advice is recorded as a concrete step, not as a court ruling or full protection.

contacts.institution: website host: privacy/customer-service and legal teams
contacts.when: after the website was created in 2020
contacts.what_was_asked: Find out why her address and phone number were disclosed and correct the safety breach.
contacts.what_institution_did: Initially denied sharing private data, then acknowledged acting on a purported subpoena and supplied it.
contacts.quote: And they were like, well, actually, we had a subpoena. And I said, a subpoena, I was like, can you please show me what this subpoena was? So they sent it to me.
contacts.what_happened_next: Her lawyer considered the subpoena deficient; the disclosure had already exposed her location.
contacts.notes: Disclosure itself is an institutional harm. No finding of a valid subpoena is assumed from the host's account.

contacts.institution: website host: chief counsel and CEO
contacts.what_was_asked: An explanation and accountability for releasing her private details to the abuser.
contacts.what_institution_did: Did not respond to her escalated complaint.
contacts.quote: I did not get a response back from them.
contacts.what_happened_next: She considered moving and instead added security precautions.
contacts.notes: The complaint email is read on air; it is a document, regardless of who authored it.

contacts.what_was_asked: Help assess danger and cope with continued threats.
contacts.what_institution_did: Heard her concerns and shared her view that escalation remained possible; no further safety intervention is described.
contacts.quote: I talked to my therapist about this. I still think he's fully capable of escalation. I think he's fully capable of killing somebody. And so does my therapist.
contacts.what_happened_next: She continued security precautions and remained fearful.

contacts.institution: custody court handling the former partner's case
contacts.what_was_asked: Resolve custody; she initially avoided appearing because she feared this judge.
contacts.what_institution_did: Repeatedly continued the case because he had not served her.
contacts.quote: He would just show up and it was like, nope, I haven't served her yet. So they'd set another date.
contacts.what_happened_next: She filed in another courthouse and attempted service herself.
contacts.notes: The complaint/application was initiated by the accused or an associate, coded third_party relative to the person harmed.

contacts.institution: private investigator hired to locate the father
contacts.what_was_asked: Locate an address so he could be served in custody proceedings.
contacts.what_institution_did: Tried to locate him but could not find an address.
contacts.quote: I had to hire a private investigator to track him down to serve him. We could not locate an address for him or the woman he was seeing.
contacts.what_happened_next: The court ultimately permitted service by publication.

contacts.what_was_asked: Proceed with custody despite inability to locate him.
contacts.what_institution_did: Allowed service by publication, then required mediation and continued proceedings.
contacts.quote: ultimately I was allowed to serve him by publication. You actually put a publication in the newspaper.
contacts.what_happened_next: The original judge combined the cases and made hers the lead case.
contacts.notes: Permission to serve by publication is a distinct concrete step.

contacts.what_was_asked: Proceed in the alternative courthouse and resolve custody.
contacts.what_institution_did: Combined the cases under the original judge, defeating the attempted change of courtroom.
contacts.quote: And so she combines the cases and makes hers the lead case. So despite all of the effort, To get it out of that courtroom, it winds up with her again.
contacts.what_happened_next: Danielle returned before the same judge.
contacts.notes: A procedural consolidation is not itself coded as proof of concealment or institutional self-protection.

contacts.what_was_asked: A full psychological and home-environment evaluation of both parties.
contacts.what_institution_did: Ordered the full evaluation and split its cost.
contacts.quote: I asked for a full mental evaluation, and she agreed. I asked for the full mental evaluation of both parties.
contacts.what_happened_next: He refused to cooperate when he learned his share would be about $3,500.
contacts.notes: The full evaluation was ordered, not shown completed; the cost-sharing direction is given in the next paragraph.

contacts.what_was_asked: Compel basic paperwork and compensate the cost of bringing him back to court.
contacts.what_institution_did: Directed him to complete paperwork and awarded her $2,500 in lawyer's fees.
contacts.quote: And of course, the judge says, you've got to fill out this basic paperwork. And the judge winds up awarding me $2,500 to cover the lawyer's fee for having to take him to court to tell him to do what he's supposed to do.
contacts.what_happened_next: He offered to negotiate; custody terms were discussed.
contacts.notes: This is an award, not evidence that money was paid or that custody was already settled.

contacts.what_was_asked: Approve the negotiated custody agreement.
contacts.what_institution_did: Rejected a clause allowing him to sue her as inappropriate to a custody agreement and requested re-signing.
contacts.quote: It wound up getting to the court and they kicked it back because they were like this line about him suing you doesn't belong in a custody agreement. They said, you need to take this out and re-sign it. So of course, he refused to resign it.
contacts.what_happened_next: They waited for the October court date.

contacts.what_was_asked: Resubmit the agreement despite his refusal to re-sign and absence.
contacts.what_institution_did: Allowed resubmission without his signature.
contacts.quote: But on the call, the court agrees to basically let us resubmit without his signature, which is a win for us. And so we're able to move forward with the custody.
contacts.what_happened_next: A signed order followed in February, as described in the update.

contacts.when: February, the month before the update; after two years of proceedings
contacts.what_was_asked: Full physical and legal custody, zero visitation, and protection from obstruction of a future adoption.
contacts.what_institution_did: Entered the custody order and added obligations to sign adoption paperwork, supply an email for notice, or bear tracing costs.
contacts.quote: They said that he must sign any paperwork related to an adoption and that if he does not give me an email address to notify him, that he waives his right for notification. And if I have to hire a private investigator to locate him in order to do whatever is necessary for this, that he must reimburse me for those expenses.
contacts.what_happened_next: She reports full custody with zero visitation and relief from the risk of him collecting the child.
contacts.notes: The year is inferred as 2023 from the update's sequence; the episode gives February and a two-year duration.

contacts.institution: detective who handled the alleged carjacking
contacts.when: by the final update; exact timing not stated
contacts.what_was_asked: The host asked about stopping the pattern of exploitation.
contacts.what_institution_did: Said he wished he could act but described the perpetrator exploiting protections in the system; no enforcement is reported.
contacts.quote: I spoke with him and he's like, I wish I could get this guy. Unfortunately, he's one of those people that uses the things in the system that are created to actually protect domestic violence victims. He's used them to exploit the system.
contacts.what_happened_next: No prosecution is reported.
contacts.notes: Contact is recounted by the host; its exact chronological position among the later custody events is not stated. It is placed last as reported in the update, not asserted to have occurred after the order.

persons.outcome_quote: and that is that I have custody of my daughter. He gets zero visitation. He has no rights.
persons.decisive_work_quote: I was getting really forceful with my lawyer. I was like, enough with his games. Get this signed.
persons.time_to_first_effective_action: Private security first assisted her July 2020 exit; the final custody order came after two years of custody proceedings.
persons.notes: Final protection is the custody order, not a conviction or the fact that she left. Earlier judicial disbelief and the website host disclosure remain institutional harms. No criminal conviction is reported. The episode describes zero visitation; the precise legal scope of the order is not independently inferred.

persons.name: Carrie
persons.harm: Her father spanked and screamed at her, threatened to abduct her and used access to her to control her mother. Her mother feared that he would collect her from school and disappear.

quotes.quote: I had thought about running away with her and just disappearing, but then I thought, this is a man who knows where my parents live and my half siblings are there, and I wasn't sure if he was capable of showing up with a gun. I mean, he'd been in the military told me he had no problem hitting women constantly. So what was going to stop him from showing up at my parents place and trying to fight my father.

contacts.what_was_asked: Protection from threats and abduction.
contacts.what_institution_did: Granted her and her mother emergency protection.
contacts.quote: Daniella and her daughter were granted an emergency order of protection by law enforcement in early July.
contacts.what_happened_next: A permanent order required a hearing.

contacts.what_was_asked: A permanent protective order against her father.
contacts.what_institution_did: Denied the mother's request despite the abduction concern.
contacts.quote: I didn't get a restraining order against him. She dismissed it.
contacts.what_happened_next: Her mother relied on family, security precautions and later custody proceedings.

contacts.what_was_asked: Protect private contact/location information.
contacts.what_institution_did: Disclosed billing data to the father, exposing the mother and daughter's safety.
contacts.quote: So you guys handed over my private information to a known abuser who sent a legally deficient subpoena. And I cannot stress enough the damage this has caused to me and my daughter's physical safety and emotional well-being.
contacts.what_happened_next: Her mother complained and added security precautions.
contacts.notes: The host did not provide a protective response; the institutional disclosure itself is the harm. Its motive is not established, so protected_itself is not inferred.

contacts.what_was_asked: Resolve custody with safeguards.
contacts.what_institution_did: Ordered a full evaluation of both parents and the home environments; it stalled over the father's refusal to pay.
contacts.quote: Once he finds out it's 3,500, he loses his shit and refuses to do anything. Now, it's the end of 2021, and we have to wait to go back to court on this. So there's no resolution.
contacts.what_happened_next: Further negotiations and court hearings followed.

contacts.what_was_asked: Approve the custody settlement.
contacts.what_institution_did: Returned the agreement because the father's proposed lawsuit clause did not belong in it.
contacts.quote: It wound up getting to the court and they kicked it back because they were like this line about him suing you doesn't belong in a custody agreement. They said, you need to take this out and re-sign it. So of course, he refused to resign it.
contacts.what_happened_next: The dispute continued to October.

contacts.what_was_asked: Proceed despite refusal to sign.
contacts.what_institution_did: Allowed resubmission without his signature.
contacts.quote: But on the call, the court agrees to basically let us resubmit without his signature, which is a win for us. And so we're able to move forward with the custody.
contacts.what_happened_next: The final signed order followed.

contacts.what_was_asked: Sole maternal custody and no paternal visitation.
contacts.what_institution_did: Issued the order and strengthened provisions preventing obstruction of adoption.
contacts.quote: and that is that I have custody of my daughter. He gets zero visitation. He has no rights.
contacts.what_happened_next: The mother describes her daughter as safe from unregulated collection and able to obtain a passport.

persons.outcome_quote: It was always risky. So it makes me feel great about that. great that I could get her a passport if I want to. I don't have these hurdles. I don't have to do with this stuff anymore.
persons.decisive_work_quote: I was getting really forceful with my lawyer. I was like, enough with his games. Get this signed.
persons.time_to_first_effective_action: After two years of custody proceedings.
persons.notes: Also transcribed as Kerry, Carey or similar. The final custody account gives her mother full legal/physical custody and zero visitation for the father. Routine emergency delivery and pediatric care do not count as responses to this abuse.

persons.name: Kenji (harassment and retaliation)
persons.harm: His ex-wife's partner threatened him and his children, attempted extortion and workplace retaliation, pursued restraining orders and accusations, and hacked a social account.

quotes.quote: If he really does have friends with the police or military friends, and he wants to come after me, he can do it. So I was concerned.
So I felt kind of stuck at that point. I wasn't sure what to do.

contacts.what_was_asked: Remove or stop the allegedly armed man at his home and protect him and the children.
contacts.what_institution_did: Arrived after the man left and said no action was available because no entry or vandalism occurred.
contacts.quote: break into your property, he didn't vandalize anything, he basically didn't do anything so there's nothing we can do but I will keep an eye out from blah blah blah and that was that.
contacts.what_happened_next: He received more harassing texts afterwards.

contacts.what_was_asked: Help respond to threats and harassment.
contacts.what_institution_did: Suggested applying for a restraining order.
contacts.quote: After this text exchange with [perpetrator], Kenji's therapist and close friends began suggesting that he should file for a restraining order of protection against [perpetrator].
contacts.what_happened_next: He delayed filing because of fears about money and connections.

contacts.institution: community crime-watch organiser and law-enforcement contacts
contacts.what_was_asked: Find out the threatening man's identity.
contacts.what_institution_did: The volunteer sought police contacts and established that the car was registered to Danielle.
contacts.quote: So he reached out to some of his law enforcement connections. We got a link to somebody who we believed was his biological father but still to this day we haven't confirmed it. And then the last piece of evidence that [community volunteer] was able to confirm for me was that his red **** it wasn't registered to him. It was registered to Danielle, his supposed ex-fiancé.
contacts.what_happened_next: The information reached Darcy; the partner escalated threats.
contacts.notes: This is a community safety group and law-enforcement-assisted enquiry, not an assertion of a formal police investigation.

contacts.what_was_asked: Investigate identity and danger to his family.
contacts.what_institution_did: Delivered a report finding a fabricated identity, few assets, suspect social-security details and other restraining-order cases.
contacts.quote: And a few days later, they sent me a report of what they had found. They found out that [perpetrator]'s name was pretty much fake. I mean there was no record of it before 2009, 2010. The identity just kind of appears out of nowhere.
contacts.what_happened_next: He shared the findings with friends and family but lacked an intervention stopping the harassment.

contacts.institution: his employer: compliance director and legal team
contacts.what_was_asked: Investigate the accusation that he misused the company database.
contacts.what_institution_did: Met him, disclosed the complaint and heard his explanation of the abuse.
contacts.quote: basically told me that [perpetrator] had filed a complaint stating that I'd used our company's database to look up personal information about him and his friends.
contacts.what_happened_next: The investigation continued.
contacts.notes: The next contact records the later result; receiving an allegation is not itself equated with believing it. The complaint/application was initiated by the accused or an associate, coded third_party relative to the person harmed.

contacts.institution: his employer: compliance director and legal team
contacts.when: a couple of weeks after the June 2020 meeting
contacts.what_was_asked: Resolve the retaliatory accusation fairly and preserve his employment.
contacts.what_institution_did: Found no evidence he searched for the complainant's information and cleared him.
contacts.quote: I was basically cleared of any wrongdoing in the investigation.
contacts.what_happened_next: He kept his job; harassment continued.

contacts.when: a few months after April 4, 2020; before the October hearing
contacts.what_was_asked: Understand the allegation and what to do.
contacts.what_institution_did: Notified him of the complaint, heard his account and advised checking whether charges were actually filed.
contacts.quote: So, your arrangement dates in October. I wouldn't really lose sleep over this until then. And then the day before your Arraignment hearing, call the court and see if any of the charges have actually been filed.
contacts.what_happened_next: He checked in October; the complainant had not filed the necessary material.
contacts.notes: Kenji describes a charge notification but also says no formal filing followed; do not infer a conviction, an arrest or a completed prosecution. The complaint/application was initiated by the accused or an associate, coded third_party relative to the person harmed.

contacts.what_was_asked: A temporary order based on months of threats and harassment.
contacts.what_institution_did: Denied his temporary request; he says the reason was not given.
contacts.quote: For some reason, the judge denies my temporary restraining order. I don't know why.
contacts.what_happened_next: Harassment continued and he later filed again.
contacts.notes: No motive for the denial is inferred.

contacts.what_was_asked: Resolve the complaint against him.
contacts.what_institution_did: Confirmed no filing and stamped proof of appearance.
contacts.quote: October comes around, I call the court. She hadn't filed anything the day before the hearing, so I go to the courthouse the next day and they just sign off and say, okay, she hasn't filed anything and here's your proof of appearance stamp, go on your way.
contacts.what_happened_next: No battery case proceeded as described; extortion did not produce the demanded payment.

contacts.what_was_asked: Regain control of his hacked account and remove defamatory content.
contacts.what_institution_did: Required a lengthy identity-verification process before releasing the account back to him.
contacts.quote: So I had to go through this lengthy process with the company to prove my identity to them so they could release the account back to me and then clean up all the mess he had made on it.
contacts.what_happened_next: He recovered access and cleaned up the account.
contacts.notes: No claim is made that the platform identified or sanctioned the hacker.

contacts.what_was_asked: Act on the account hacking.
contacts.what_institution_did: Declined to investigate, citing proof difficulties and the low-level charge even with proof.
contacts.quote: And he pretty much admitted well, there's not much he can do because first of all, you'd have to prove that he was the one who actually hacked into your account. And even if I could provide all the proof necessary, I mean, it would just end up being a misdemeanor charge, which would result in pretty much a slap on [perpetrator] wrist. And he was basically saying the police department wasn't gonna have a detective go and investigate all this just for a misdemeanor, which made sense to me,
contacts.what_happened_next: He remained frustrated and exposed to further harassment.

contacts.what_was_asked: Defend against the new restraining-order application.
contacts.what_institution_did: Advised a counter-application; he organised witnesses and evidence.
contacts.quote: when I tell my lawyer about this, and she suggests that we file a restraining order in response because, yeah, this is bullshit. He's going to drag me to court over again another set of false accusations and
contacts.what_happened_next: A combined hearing took place in February.

contacts.what_was_asked: Dismiss the accusation against him.
contacts.what_institution_did: Rejected the partner's evidence and denied his request against Kenji.
contacts.quote: first of all, she denies his restraining order against me saying she doesn't find any credibility to his claims that I've harassed him or done anything to threaten him.
contacts.what_happened_next: Kenji then received a ruling on his own request.

contacts.what_was_asked: Obtain his own protective order.
contacts.what_institution_did: Denied it, doubting the completeness of his text evidence and Darcy's credibility.
contacts.quote: By then, she turns around and makes a ruling on my restraining order, and she denies my restraining order also. When we asked for an explanation, she basically says that she wasn't sure if my testimony was 100% credible. She felt like I had left out some context and some of the text messages I had attached, which wasn't true, by the way.
contacts.what_happened_next: He focused on keeping the children away from the partner through co-parenting arrangements.
contacts.notes: No later protective order for Kenji is reported.

persons.outcome_quote: I was basically cleared of any wrongdoing in the investigation.
persons.decisive_work_quote: I was basically cleared of any wrongdoing in the investigation.
persons.time_to_first_effective_action: Employer cleared him a couple of weeks after the June 2020 interview; earlier enquiries had not stopped the harassment.
persons.notes: Employer investigation cleared him and the battery complaint did not proceed, but he did not receive the restraining order he sought. Later updates do not establish that all harassment stopped. Outcome is partial, reflecting those discrete protections, not a claim that the abuser was stopped. Exact date of the later battery-complaint call is unspecified; it is placed near the October court outcome.

persons.name: Kenji (marital harm)
persons.harm: His wife's abrupt departure, deception, coercive arguments and physical struggle over his keys caused sustained distress; later co-parenting conflict continued.

quotes.quote: Partially because I was afraid to. I'm the type of person, I don't usually lean on people when I have a problem. I don't know if that's just my upbringing or part of being a guy, but guys don't really, our generation were raised to be tough. You don't talk about your feelings. You don't cry. You don't do this. You don't do that. You kind of suck it up and move forward.

contacts.what_was_asked: Repair the marriage and cope with the crisis.
contacts.what_institution_did: Provided joint counselling and encouraged him to seek support from friends and family.
contacts.quote: The therapist told me it was really important for me to kind of like Go lean on my friends family anybody I could and kind of get that support
contacts.what_happened_next: He sought support; the separation continued.

contacts.what_was_asked: A further attempt to discuss the relationship.
contacts.what_institution_did: Ended the unproductive call with his wife and recognised possible coaching by the other man.
contacts.quote: because she's not giving us anything to work with and not really cooperating. And the first thing my therapist says to me was like, I think someone was in the background on that phone call.
contacts.what_happened_next: He continued individual weekly therapy; no reconciliation or protection from the marital harm is described.

contacts.what_was_asked: Emotional support.
contacts.what_institution_did: Provided continuing support; he calls her a rock.
contacts.quote: And I have a therapist too. She's been like a rock for me through this whole situation as of July when I had gotten contact with her.
contacts.what_happened_next: He retained anxiety about calls and the children's safety.
contacts.notes: Support and coping help are not automatically coded as institutional protection from the underlying harm.

persons.outcome_quote: I do feel like she's this toxic piece of my life that I have to kind of just manage and deal with now.
